content: Official UR3e URDF/xacro: UniversalRobots/Universal_Robots_ROS2_Description (github, official, xacro-based, needs generation). Ready-to-use flat ur3e.urdf also available in Daniella1/urdf_files_dataset (ros-industrial derived) and automaticaddison/ur_robotiq. All provide DH-consistent joint chain + mesh references for direct use with urdf-loader.
